mainEntity.name: How long does the custom fire pit construction process typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for custom fire pit construction varies based on design complexity, material choices, site preparation requirements, and permitting processes. A straightforward design might take 2-4 weeks from initial design approval to completion. More elaborate projects involving extensive masonry work, gas line installation, or landscape integration could extend to 4-8 weeks or longer. Our process typically begins with a consultation and design phase, followed by material sourcing, site preparation, construction, and final finishing. We will provide a detailed project timeline after understanding your specific requirements during the initial consultation.
